metadata.title: Eduardo Serrano | Fullstack Web Developer
metadata.description: Fullstack web developer specializing in building scalable applications with React, Next.js, Node.js, and NestJS. Explore my portfolio, projects, and experience.

introSection.name: Eduardo Serrano
introSection.title: Fullstack Web Developer
introSection.description: Crafting scalable web applications with modern technologies. Passionate about building user-friendly interfaces and robust backend systems.

aboutMeSection.title: About Me
aboutMeSection.parragraphFirst: In 2020, I discovered web development during the pandemic and became immediately captivated. What began as curiosity transformed into genuine passion. By 2021, I decided to pursue it professionally and enrolled in an intensive 380-hour bootcamp where I mastered full-stack development with Ruby on Rails, launching my career in tech.
aboutMeSection.parragraphSecond: Today, I focus on delivering high-quality, maintainable code by implementing best practices and adopting the right technologies for each project. I’m driven by continuous improvement, staying current with emerging tools and methodologies to enhance my capabilities as a developer.
aboutMeSection.parragraphThird: Beyond work, I’m passionate about gaming, spending time with my dogs, and exploring new technologies. Currently, I’m experimenting with game development using Unity and enjoy scuba diving whenever possible.

Orbis Corp SA.description: Building and maintaining production applications while refactoring React and Next.js codebases for improved maintainability. Leading the migration of PHP backends to NestJS and resolving architectural issues. Designing and implementing a secure election management system, including database architecture, API implementation in Ruby on Rails, and frontend development with Next.js.

Kikoya.description: Collaborated with customer support teams to identify and resolve bugs, implementing comprehensive tests for each fix and feature. Mentored fellow trainees through technical challenges and facilitated clear communication between clients and development teams by translating complex technical concepts.

Le Wagon.description: Delivered personalized instruction to diverse cohorts, adapting content to meet individual learning needs. Provided constructive feedback and tracked student progress, offering additional mentoring to support their development and ensure achievement of learning objectives.

Dellomondo SA.description: Managed inventory operations and cultivated strong supplier relationships to optimize procurement and minimize carrying costs. Oversaw international and domestic logistics, customs clearance, and freight management. Led sales and operations teams, successfully resolving customer concerns while maintaining profitability.

Duolingo Clone - Lingo.description: A full-featured language learning platform built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Neon. Integrated Clerk for authentication and Stripe for payment processing. Includes an admin dashboard for creating and managing courses and lessons.

Omnifoods.description: A responsive landing page for a food delivery service. Built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to demonstrate proficiency with modern layout techniques including CSS Grid and Flexbox.

POW checkout page.description: A fully responsive e-commerce checkout page designed with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Utilized Bootstrap to ensure consistent styling and optimal responsiveness across all devices.
